title: Prompt the user to classify every new network connected to as "trusted/home/work" or "public/insecure" when using a zone-based firewall
line: When firewalld is running, connecting to a network that has no firewall zone yet shows a notification asking whether it is a home or work network or a public one, and saves the answer as its zone.
explanation: Firewalld applies different rules per network only once a connection has a firewall zone, but Plasma never asked for one: the zone could only be picked by hand in the connection editor, which most users never open. So every network ended up in the firewall's default zone, trusted or not. A new FirewallZoneMonitor in the networkmanagement kded module now watches Wi-Fi and wired connections; when one is activated without a zone and firewalld is running (its zone list includes home and public), it shows a persistent notification asking whether this is a home or work network or a public one, and saves the answer as the connection's zone (home or public).

commits.message:
kded: ask whether a new network is home/work or public with firewalld

Firewalld only treats a network differently once it has a zone, which
users rarely set. When a Wi-Fi or wired connection without one is
activated, ask whether it is a home or work network or a public one.

BUG: 425656

media.caption: Master with firewalld running: connecting to the new network CafeGuest only says it was activated; the connection stays without a firewall zone.
With the change: the same connection asks whether CafeGuest is a home or work network or a public one.
